sources.title: GitHub - openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak ...
sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: Introducing Whisper - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've trained and are open-sourcing a neural net called Whisper that approaches human level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition.

sources.snippet: dimavz/whisper-tiny Whisper is a pre-trained model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation.

sources.title: Build a Local Voice Assistant with Whisper + Ollama (2026)
sources.snippet: Build a private voice assistant that runs entirely on your machine. Whisper for speech-to-text, Ollama for the brain, and pyttsx3 for text-to-speech.

sources.title: Whisper (speech recognition system) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Whisper is a machine learning model for speech recognition and transcription, created by OpenAI and first released as open-source software in September 2022. [4]
